label: gym_ghost_010_receptionist_02
text: Let me register you as a challenger. Your name is\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], yes?

label: gym_ghost_010_receptionist_03
text: Great! Now, in order to face Gym Leader Ryme,\nyou’ll first need to pass the Gym Test.

label: gym_ghost_010_receptionist_04
text: Here at the Montenevera Gym, that means\nwarming up the audience for the main event!\r\nThat’s right—you’re the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]opening act[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_ghost_010_receptionist_05
text: Your job is to get up on the stage, show us some\ndead fierce Pokémon battles, and get the crowd\r\nexcited before the Gym Leader’s concert begins!

label: gym_ghost_010_receptionist_06
text: You can start the Gym Test by speaking with\nMC Sledge in front of the stage outside.

label: gym_ghost_010_receptionist_07
text: Now get out there and have fun!
